case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready for this job, and we would like to put that capacity to work on the pump shaft for our new HX series. As one family company to another, we want a fair solution for both of us.

That is why we are being open with you about where your offer stands.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On competition:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material cost:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It reflects the quality record, the competing offer and the direction of bar prices, and it gives you a clear job for your shop floor. Several bidders are competing, and the award goes to the best overall package.

If Option A works for you, please tell me directly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Our options are built for that: a clear structure that lets you plan, and a lead time that is shorter than the one in your offer.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the cost side:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longest payment term of the three and the shortest lead time, at a unit price that reflects the quality record and the alloy surcharge movement above.

Several bidders are competing for this pump shaft, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance, but we would like to see yours stand out.

Please let me know which option you can take forward.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

Your price for the HX pump shaft reached us, and we want to reply to it as one family company to another, openly and without detours. You are a reliable supplier to us, and that is why we are putting a complete proposal in front of you now.

On the competing offer:
Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).

On quality:
Your quality was 318 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

The award goes to the best overall package, and we cannot promise it in advance. Option A is the package we can approve: its price reflects the competing offer, and its lead time and payment terms are clear and easy to plan with.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Please send us your answer on Option A. We would like to build the HX series with a partner we know, and we hope you will make that possible with a fair solution for both our companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the alloy surcharge and the quality record you mentioned, and we can drop the price to €31.00. 

Our current offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. If you absolutely need 35 days lead time, we can manage it, but it will cost more, not less! 

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit. This alternative is at standard terms: a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. But we have to stick to the 52 days lead time because our factory is super busy right now. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.
